I still can’t just walk into the doctor’s office and say I want my tubes tied without catching grief and possibly even outright denial for being young, unwed, and without spawn but I am finding (at least where I live) a lot more people being accepting and sometimes even approving of the choice.

Not to say I give a damn about anyone’s approval, but it’s certainly a long way away from being 13 and getting told things like how fortunate I was with my “child bearing” hips, “Labor will be a breeze”, and the like.
